conclusion: Preliminary (seed 7, mse only): OLS linear model achieved lower MSE than the matched training-mean baseline on clean labels (0.17046895861013783 vs 12.888358499556563). This is a single-seed, single-metric preliminary result and does not establish general scientific value.
limitations: Only seed 7 was run; seeds 19 and 31 were not executed.
Only mse was computed; mae and median_absolute_error were not computed.
Single seed and single metric cannot support generalization claims.
No statistical significance testing was performed.
Results are specific to this synthetic task configuration (outlier_fraction 0.0) and do not imply broader scientific value.
